releaseNotes: Nokiatis MUC 1.17.3-beta.1 — Nokiatis Intelligence learns, remembers, and tells you. THE AI NOW REMEMBERS WHO YOU ARE: every play, completion and skip — with the real seconds you actually heard — syncs to Nokiatis Cloud and unions across every device you sign in on, so a new phone starts warm and the taste graph rebuilds itself; the web launcher writes the same AI block, so listening on the phone and on nokiatis.muc.vercel.app feeds one taste profile. UPDATE NOTIFICATIONS: a real Android system notification on the new Updates channel whenever a release arrives — stable AND beta (when you opted into the beta channel; skipped betas stay silent). SPOTIFY-GRADE SOUND: a new Master equalizer preset (warm low end, forward vocals, airy top) with gentle bass boost and loudness normalization, enabled by default for new installs. THE HALO, FOR GOOD: the header glow is drawn inside a forced-square SVG box, so it is a mathematically true circle on every screen, theme and switch — the square-halo bug is dead at the root, and the build workflow's branch trigger was repaired so pushes build again. This is a BETA for the 1.18 decision: it never locks the app and can always be skipped. ملخص عربي: الذكاء صار يتذكرك عبر السحابة — كل استماعك يُوحَّد عبر أجهزتك، وإشعار نظام حقيقي يصلك عند أي تحديث حتى البيتا، ومعادل صوت Master بمستوى Spotify مفعّل افتراضيًا، وهالة الرأس دائرة مضمونة نهائيًا.
